page: Amazon Web Services r6id.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 virtual CPUs utilizing the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and network connectivity delivers a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the r6id.16xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and PassMark CPU encryption tests. Its memory subsystem achieves average read-only large block bandwidth of 166.18 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth of 67.32 GB/sec. Database operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by strong PassMark database scores and static web serving throughput of 45.84 GB/sec. Additionally, the processor's AVX-512 and cryptography extensions support accelerated workloads, yielding strong results in software compilation and ray tracing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r6id.16xlarge offers high resource density by bundling substantial memory capacity with high-speed local NVMe SSD storage on a dedicated hardware profile. This eliminates the need for separate network-attached storage for high-throughput local operations, though the lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy parallel acceleration. This instance is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale relational databases, real-time analytics, software compilation pipelines, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
